summary: The MaintUserStudent module manages the maintenance of student user accounts within the HSPnet application. It allows system administrators to create, modify, and manage user credentials, enable or disable accounts, change passwords, track support comments, and manage email notifications related to user accounts. It provides validations, feedback to administrators, and integrates with SSO (Single Sign-On) where applicable.
purpose: To enable the creation, update, and support of student user accounts, including user ID and password maintenance, account activation/deactivation, email notifications (including password delivery), password change workflow, and support comment tracking.

workflows.name: Create Student User
steps: Administrator enters UserName, Email, and related student information.
System checks for duplicate user names.
If no duplicate, system generates a new password (minimum 12 characters, must meet complexity rules).
If SSO is enabled for the user, IssueEmail is set to false and the system creates the user without password email delivery.
If SSO is not enabled, IssueEmail can be sent to user.
User is created and added to system; warning or informational messages provided as feedback regarding SSO or email delivery.

workflows.name: Modify Existing Student User
steps: Administrator loads an existing student user.
Administrator can change UserName, Email, enable/disable account, and indicate IssueEmail.
System checks SSO setting and updates the user accordingly.
System sends feedback if SSO UPN is missing or present.
On enabling a user, IssueEmail can be sent if appropriate.
Password change may be initiated if user was previously disabled and now enabled.

workflows.name: Change Student User Password
steps: Administrator clicks change password.
New password and confirmation are entered.
Password validators enforce length (12), character mix (letters, digits, uppercase/lowercase, symbol), and match.
If validations pass, password is updated and, if IssueEmail is checked, sent to user by email.
Status message shown regarding email delivery and password change.

workflows.name: Manage Support Comments
steps: Administrator views/edits support comments per user.
Support comment and last updated date are displayed and can be updated.
Administrator saves or cancels comment changes.

business_rules: UserName must be unique among student users.
Email must be valid and required.
Password must be at least 12 characters, contain upper and lower case, digits, and symbols.
If SSO is enabled for a student, IssueEmail cannot be used for sending credentials.
Support comments are tracked and displayed including the last updated date.
Change password workflow and email notifications depend on account state and SSO status.
validations: NewPassword: Required (on change), must match complexity (length, character class)
calculations: Status feedback based on SSO/Email/Password change actions
conditions: If SSO is enabled for student, email delivery (IssueEmail) is hidden and password is not emailed.
If account is disabled, Change Password button is hidden.
New student user triggers Create workflow, existing user triggers Modify workflow.
Show/hide warning and error panels based on processing outcomes.
system_behavior: Page initializes with student and user information.
Panels for error, warning, password change, and support comment are dynamically shown/hidden.
All actions are logged via UserSession.Messages.
AJAX and client-side scripts used for panel management and validations.
Feedback is presented in context (e.g. warnings for SSO-without-UPN).
exceptions: User already exists (UserDuplicate, UserDuplicateAdd): Error shown, operation blocked.
Account creation without valid email: Error/warning.
Failure to send email: Warning shown.
Invalid or missing SSO details: Warning shown.
